notes.title: NUN Demo Released
notes.notes:
Today we released the demo for NUN. We hope you enjoy playing it! We welcome and encourage any and all feedback/discussion. If you liked the game, please write us a short review. If you experienced issues, please tell us about that, as well. If you are excited to play the full game, then add it to your wishlist here on Steam, and please share NUN with anyone you know who might like it.

Cheers!

-Zilla 
BLUNT Digital Media Collective
